topic: Depositing a Check at the Bank

script.title: THE BIRTHDAY CHECK
script.story_hook: A birthday check meets its first bank lesson.
script.intro_zh: 一張外婆給的紅包支票,讓她學會背書與保留期限。
script.welcome_en: Hi! Today: depositing a paper check.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來學到銀行存支票。
script.outro: Sixty lines — that check is all yours. Enjoy Friday!
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,這張支票全是你的。週五快樂!
script.practice_intro_en: Your turn — read each line along with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 換你了——每句跟著我一起唸。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful teenage girl with long dark braided hair and round glasses, wearing a lavender hoodie, black leggings and high-top sneakers, small frame, holding a paper envelope
script.char_b_description: a tall elderly man with close-cropped white hair and a neat white mustache, wearing a powder-blue button shirt with a striped bank vest, dark slacks and polished oxfords, kind crinkled eyes

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to deposit this check.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə dɪˈpɑzɪt ðɪs tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 你好,我想存這張支票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Paper or mobile?
dialogue.zh: 好啊。紙本存,還是手機存?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, what's the difference?
dialogue.zh: 呃,有什麼差別嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under two hundred, mobile is faster.
dialogue.zh: 兩百塊以下,用手機存比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one's from my grandma. Three hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌnz frʌm maɪ ˈɡræmə θri ˈhʌndrəd/
dialogue.zh: 這張是外婆給我的,三百塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aw, birthday money? Counter it is, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔ ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ ˈmʌni ˈkaʊntər ɪts ɪz ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 真窩心,生日紅包?那就臨櫃存吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counter — you mean this desk?
dialogue.zh: 臨櫃——是指這個櫃台嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly! May I see the front?
dialogue.zh: 沒錯!我可以看看支票正面嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here you go — grandma's handwriting.
dialogue.zh: 給您——外婆親筆寫的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lovely. Now the back — did you sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌvli naʊ ðə bæk dɪd ju saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 字真漂亮。背面呢——您簽名了嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… just sign the back, right?
dialogue.zh: 好……只要在背面簽名,對嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's called endorsing the check.
dialogue.zh: 那叫做「背書」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Endorsing… is that like a receipt?
dialogue.zh: 背書……是類似收據的東西嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No — it says the money is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt sɛz ðə ˈmʌni ɪz jʊrz/
dialogue.zh: 不是——簽了名,代表這筆錢是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, I never knew that.
dialogue.zh: 哇,我以前都不知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people don't. Signature, please.
dialogue.zh: 大部分的人都不清楚。請簽個名吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! Can I get cash today?
dialogue.zh: 簽好了!今天能領到現金嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Part of it — there's a hold.
dialogue.zh: 只能領一部分——這張有保留期限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hold? What does that mean?
dialogue.zh: 保留?那是什麼意思?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We release some now, rest by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi rɪˈlis səm naʊ rɛst baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 現在先給你一部分,剩下的週五入帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why hold it? Grandma's check!
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要保留?這是外婆的支票耶!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big checks get checked, that's all.
dialogue.zh: 大額支票都要再確認,就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So Friday, everything unlocks?
dialogue.zh: 那到了週五,就全部解鎖了?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every cent. It's automatic now.
dialogue.zh: 一毛不少,現在系統會自動處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Um, so how much cash today?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm soʊ haʊ mʌtʃ kæʃ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好,那今天能領多少現金?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred — fifties or twenties?
dialogue.zh: 一百塊——要五十面額的,還是二十的?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh… hundreds, please. Simple.
dialogue.zh: 呃……有大的請給我大的,簡單點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll grab a hundred. Next, mobile?
dialogue.zh: 哈,我拿一張一百的。接著,要不要認識手機存款?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app? Is that really allowed?
dialogue.zh: 用手機應用嗎?真的可以嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snap the front, snap the back.
dialogue.zh: 正面拍一張,背面再拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just take pictures of a check?
dialogue.zh: 就是把支票拍照存進去?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it. The bank does the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt ðə bæŋk dʌz ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣,剩下的銀行會處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool… but today's was big.
dialogue.zh: 好棒棒……不過我這張金額太大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Over two-fifty, come to the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊvər tu ˈfɪfti kʌm tə ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 超過兩百五十,就得來櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. Where's my receipt?
dialogue.zh: 知道了。我的收據呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here! It shows the Friday amount.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡!上面寫著週五入帳的金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no… wait a second.
dialogue.zh: 噢,糟糕……等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What's wrong? You look worried.
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了?你看起來很擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom wants this cash Friday.
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽週五要用這筆現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hold covers that — no problem.
dialogue.zh: 保留期剛好對上——沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday morning, all of it?
dialogue.zh: 週五早上,全部都能領?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We open at nine. Bring the receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈoʊpən ət naɪn brɪŋ ðə rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 我們九點開門。記得帶收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry — one more thing. The app…
dialogue.zh: 不好意思——還有件事。那個應用……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Download it, then tap 'Deposit.'
dialogue.zh: 先下載應用,再點「存款」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my little checks go straight in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ ˈlɪtəl tʃɛks ɡoʊ streɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那小額支票就那樣直接入帳?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and call before you drive over.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd kɔl bɪˈfɔr ju draɪv ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 對,不過要跑這一趟前,先打電話來問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You thought of everything, huh?
dialogue.zh: 什麼都替我想到了,是吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my favorite part of the job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ ˈfeɪvərət pɑrt əv ðə dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 這可是我最喜歡這份工作的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New friend by Friday, deal?
dialogue.zh: 那就週五見,交個新朋友,好嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal! Have a wonderful week.
dialogue.zh: 好啊!祝你這週愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — can I take a picture of the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt kæn aɪ teɪk ə ˈpɪktʃər əv ðə rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 等等——我可以幫收據拍張照嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Smart kids keep photos.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。聰明的孩子都留照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snap! Perfect. Thank you so much.
dialogue.zh: 拍好了!太完美了,真的很謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. See you Friday morning.
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。週五早上見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three hundred, one hundred now, two later.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈhʌndrəd wʌn ˈhʌndrəd naʊ tu ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 三百塊,現在拿到一百,剩下的之後入帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You just learned bank math!
dialogue.zh: 你剛學會了銀行的算數題!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! And a new word: endorsement.
dialogue.zh: 哈!還學到新詞:背書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it Friday — I'll be watching.
dialogue.zh: 週五用得上——我會看著你喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will! Bye, and thank you again.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl baɪ ænd θæŋk ju əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我會的!再見,再次感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Enjoy that birthday weekend.
dialogue.zh: 再見!好好享受你的週末慶生吧。
